messages:
kira: noticed a bump in mTLS handshake failures in na-west and eu-west since 07:10 UTC. proxies log "keystore: unwrap denied" referencing alias/rotating-key-2026. Anyone touching KMS/keypolicy or RBAC overnight?

sam: I pushed a key rotation job and an RBAC cleanup last night (removed old role ARNs). Rotation completed but key-policy updater reported a few warnings.

omar: sample log:
```
2026-08-12T07:11:03Z ingress-12 INFO handshake failed err=keystore: unwrap denied key=alias/rotating-key-2026 req=ab12fc
kms: AccessDenied for arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/keystore-agent-new when calling KMS:Decrypt
```

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rbacs/keystore-prune rolled out 2026-08-12T01:05Z. keypolicy-updater: warnings for aliases [alias/rotating-key-2026, alias/session-ticket-na-west].

oncall: paging SRE. this is causing increased full-handshake rates and a small latency spike for affected regions.

kira: quick mitigations: revert RBAC rename OR add the new role ARN to affected key policies. Which is faster?

sam: adding ARN to key-policy is fastest but needs key-owner approval in some regions. Revert is safe if we want immediate relief.

omar: CloudTrail shows kms:Decrypt denies and some denies missing principal fields (audit gap). Audit-bot, can you confirm?

audit-bot: CloudTrail entries present for 07:10-07:15, but ~20% of denies for that window have null Principal due to delayed delivery. Filing ticket with cloud infra. Ticket AUD-2026-4242.

kira: plan:
- (P0) add keystore-agent-new ARN to key policy for alias/rotating-key-2026 in na-west and eu-west (sam) ETA 10m
- (P0) run canary decrypt and a TLS probe (omar) ETA 15m
- (P1) add preflight diff to RBAC rename job to verify KMS key policies include affected principals (kira) ETA PR

sam: patching key policies now. snippet applied: Statement Allow Principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/keystore-agent-new Action kms:Decrypt

infra-bot: keypolicy-updater: applied patch in na-west at 07:22:10Z, eu-west at 07:23:05Z. propagation ok.

omar: canary decrypt ok (req=canary-rot-01 status=200 decrypt_ms=31). running TLS probe across 6 proxies.

oncall: TLS probe results: 6/6 nodes resumed handshake successfully; error rate back to baseline.

kira: leaving old role ARN in key policies for 48h as fallback. follow-ups: make keypolicy-updater fail the deploy on warnings for critical aliases; add alert for keystore unwrap_denied > 0.5% for 5m; escalate CloudTrail delivery gap.

audit-bot: AUD-2026-4242 created for missing principal fields; cloud infra engaged.

sam: filing PR to add RBAC preflight and to add a smoke decrypt step in rotation playbook.

kira: postmortem owner: kira. SLA impact: ~12m elevated handshake latency, limited tenant impact. I'll open incident doc and link when ready. Thanks team.
